pensamiento:
I'm checking the first user story, QUS-001. It has a role ("user") and an action, so it passes, though the role is generic. The language is mixed, but other stories in the backlog are in English too, so that doesn't look like a real defect.

I'm going through the remaining criteria, QUS-002 through QUS-009, and they look fine. QUS-006 is the exception: "respond quickly" has no measurable threshold, so that one fails.

I'm moving through the remaining checks: the invariants INV-002 through INV-005 and the first dependency check. Value looks explicit enough, but estimability and verifiability are missing: there's no defined scope and no acceptance criteria, so those fail as blockers.

I'm working through the DOR checks now. The app's backend isn't clearly needed from what's described, so DOR-001 looks fine. For DOR-002, the response-time threshold is an implicit business rule that's missing, since "respond quickly" gives no limit, so I'm marking that as a defect.

I'm marking the non-functional requirements as a gap: performance is clearly the point of this story, but there's no measurable target for it. Since the scope is unclear, I'll register the estimate as 1 and note that scope needs clarifying before estimating properly, then pull the estimation scale and reference stories in parallel before recording the result.

Indicar el alcance para estimar: qué pantallas o acciones de la app están incluidas, en qué plataformas (web, móvil) y si se trata de un ajuste puntual o de una revisión general del rendimiento.

Agregar criterios de aceptación en formato de reglas o lista de verificación, cada uno con un resultado comprobable (por ejemplo: 'Al pulsar [acción], la respuesta visible aparece en menos de X segundos en condiciones Y').

Definir el umbral de tiempo de respuesta esperado y el comportamiento cuando no se cumple (por ejemplo, mensaje de carga o indicador de progreso después de X segundos). Sin estos datos, el equipo no puede validar la regla.
Declarar al menos un requisito de rendimiento medible (tiempo de respuesta en percentil, con su volumen o condición de carga), ya que el rendimiento es el objetivo central de esta HU.
